import requests

from fxrates.convert import convert_amount


def test_convert_uses_live_rate():
    resp = requests.get("https://api.exchangerate.host/latest?base=USD&symbols=EUR", timeout=10)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    rate = resp.json()["rates"]["EUR"]
    result = convert_amount(100, "USD", "EUR", rate=rate)
    assert result == round(100 * rate, 2)

import smtplib

from notifier.mailer import build_message


def test_digest_message_is_accepted_by_relay():
    msg = build_message(to="ops@example.org", subject="Daily digest", body="3 jobs failed")
    with smtplib.SMTP("smtp.mailgun.org", 587, timeout=15) as relay:
        relay.ehlo()
        refused = relay.send_message(msg, from_addr="noreply@example.org")
    assert refused == {}

import os

import tempfile

from pipeline.stages import dedupe_partitions


def test_dedupe_removes_duplicate_partitions():
    root = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "dedupe-partitions")
    shutil.rmtree(root, ignore_errors=True)
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(root, "day=2024-01-01"))
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(root, "day=2024-01-01.copy"))
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(root, "day=2024-01-02"))
    removed = dedupe_partitions(root)
    assert removed == ["day=2024-01-01.copy"]
    assert sorted(os.listdir(root)) == ["day=2024-01-01", "day=2024-01-02"]
    shutil.rmtree(root)

import os
import tempfile
import unittest

from configparse.loader import load_layered


class LayeredLoadTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_override_file_wins(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="layered-") as root:
            base = os.path.join(root, "base.toml")
            override = os.path.join(root, "override.toml")
            with open(base, "w") as fh:
                fh.write("[server]\nport = 8080\nworkers = 2\n")
            with open(override, "w") as fh:
                fh.write("[server]\nworkers = 8\n")
            cfg = load_layered([base, override])
        self.assertEqual(cfg["server"], {"port": 8080, "workers": 8})

import json
import subprocess
import sys


def run_schema_check(payload_path):
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-m", "schemacheck", "--json", payload_path],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    if proc.returncode not in (0, 1):
        raise RuntimeError(f"schemacheck crashed: {proc.stderr.strip()}")
    report = json.loads(proc.stdout)
    verdict = report["verdict"]
    if verdict not in ("pass", "fail"):
        raise RuntimeError(f"unknown verdict {verdict!r}")
    return verdict == "pass", report["errors"]


def test_invoice_payload_matches_schema():
    ok, errors = run_schema_check("tests/fixtures/invoice_v3.json")
    assert (ok, errors) == (True, [])

from webapp.events import EventBus
from webapp.handlers import register_signup_handlers


def test_signup_sends_welcome_email():
    bus = EventBus()
    sent = []
    register_signup_handlers(bus, mailer=sent.append)

    def on_sent(event):
        assert event.payload["template"] == "welcome"
        assert event.payload["to"] == "new.user@example.org"

    bus.subscribe("email.sent", on_sent)
    bus.publish("user.signed_up", {"email": "new.user@example.org"})

from media.probe import probe_file


def test_probe_reports_video_stream_metadata():
    info = probe_file("tests/media/clip_1080p_30fps.mp4")
    video = [s for s in info.streams if s.kind == "video"]
    assert len(video) == 1
    assert (video[0].width, video[0].height) == (1920, 1080)
    assert video[0].frame_rate == 30
    assert video[0].codec == "h264"

import subprocess

from relnotes.changelog import since_last_tag


def test_changelog_lists_commits_since_tag(tmp_path):
    repo = tmp_path / "proj"
    repo.mkdir()

    def git(*args):
        subprocess.run(["git", *args], cwd=repo, check=True, capture_output=True)

    git("init", "-q")
    (repo / "a.txt").write_text("one\n")
    git("add", "a.txt")
    git("commit", "-q", "-m", "feat: first")
    git("tag", "v1.0.0")
    (repo / "b.txt").write_text("two\n")
    git("add", "b.txt")
    git("commit", "-q", "-m", "fix: second")
    assert since_last_tag(str(repo)) == ["fix: second"]

import subprocess

from shipit.publish import publish_release


def git(*args, cwd):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *args], cwd=cwd, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout


def test_publish_pushes_release_branch(tmp_path):
    remote, work = tmp_path / "origin.git", tmp_path / "work"
    git("init", "-q", "--bare", str(remote), cwd=tmp_path)
    git("init", "-q", str(work), cwd=tmp_path)
    for key, value in [("user.name", "CI"), ("user.email", "ci@example.invalid"),
                       ("commit.gpgsign", "false"), ("core.hooksPath", "")]:
        git("config", key, value, cwd=work)
    (work / "VERSION").write_text("2.1.0\n")
    git("add", "VERSION", cwd=work)
    git("commit", "-q", "-m", "2.1.0", cwd=work)
    git("remote", "add", "origin", str(remote), cwd=work)
    publish_release(str(work), branch="release/2.1")
    assert git("rev-parse", "release/2.1", cwd=remote) == git("rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=work)

import subprocess

from shipit.publish import publish_release


def git(*args, cwd):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *args], cwd=cwd, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout


def init_repo(path, bare=False):
    git("init", "-q", *(["--bare"] if bare else []), str(path), cwd=path.parent)
    for key, value in [("user.name", "CI"), ("user.email", "ci@example.invalid"),
                       ("commit.gpgsign", "false"), ("core.hooksPath", "")]:
        git("config", key, value, cwd=path)


def test_publish_pushes_release_branch(tmp_path):
    remote, work = tmp_path / "origin.git", tmp_path / "work"
    init_repo(remote, bare=True)
    init_repo(work)
    (work / "VERSION").write_text("2.1.0\n")
    git("add", "VERSION", cwd=work)
    git("commit", "-q", "-m", "2.1.0", cwd=work)
    git("remote", "add", "origin", str(remote), cwd=work)
    publish_release(str(work), branch="release/2.1")
    assert git("rev-parse", "release/2.1", cwd=remote) == git("rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=work)
